kept.poolKey: COMBINATION C1: a high rung on a working approach
kept.spine: A carter says the spread of trades here keeps more people at work than the traffic on the road would account for.

kept.poolKey: INCOME MIX: two or three sources between them
kept.spine: At the taverns they say the town lives on a short list of trades, and that a household drawing on only one of them is reckoned careless.

kept.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
kept.spine: By a traveller's account the stalls here carry the town's own work beside other towns' goods, with no seller troubling to say which is which.
The yards are full of goods bound out, and a drover says no two of the loads he takes are the same.
Rundgate feeds itself, with a little left at the end of a season for the store.
Garrison stands, and the supply it is kept on has failed somewhere further up the road.

A little of the trade here never reaches a book, small enough to annoy the under-clerks of the hall and too small to change what the town is. Whose little it is appears in no account, and the town keeps both a black market and a Thieves' Guild: it would be worth the asking.
